title: ViewSlice
description: Per-device slice returned over the view-federation/1.0.0 libp2p protocol; signed by the responding peer's agent key. Source of truth: composed at the responding peer from its local projection of the requested view kind (Operational, Category C — the meta-shape that federates cluster + topology views across household peers). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

peerId.description: libp2p PeerId of the responding peer.

viewKind.description: Which view kind this slice represents — drives the payload's expected shape.

freshness.description: Liveness/staleness of the slice as observed at the responding peer.

payload.description: View-kind-specific slice body. Open shape at the envelope level — the consumer interprets payload per viewKind.

signature.description: Base64 signature over canonical_bytes(viewKind, peerId, freshness, payload).
